links.outcome: Patient-reported communication and satisfaction ratings after AI scribe deployment, pilot vs control physicians (difference-in-differences)
links.effect: Pre-post change in communication and satisfaction scores did not differ significantly between pilot and control physicians; three items rose for pilot physicians and declined for controls without reaching significance.
links.quote: The pre-post change in communication and satisfaction scores did not differ significantly between pilot and control physicians.

links.outcome: Patient experience and satisfaction with AI-enabled visits measured with patient surveys in a pilot evaluation
links.effect: Among 31,917 surveys (7,164 pilot; 24,753 control), no significant difference in pre-post change in patient ratings between pilot and control physicians.
links.quote: We did not find evidence of AI scribes worsening or enhancing patient experiences.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the clinical deployment of ambient listening AI scribes on patient-reported communication and satisfaction ratings.
